item.title: Parallelized Boid Simulation (MPI, Python)
item.description:
Overview

Implemented a parallelized flocking dynamics simulation using the classic boid algorithm with MPI for distributed computing.

🔗 GitHub Repository

Key Features

  • Boid Rules: Implemented standard flocking behaviors including separation, alignment, and cohesion

  • MPI Parallelization: Distributed computation across multiple processes for efficient simulation of large agent populations

  • Scalability: Designed for scaling to thousands of agents through spatial partitioning

Technical Details

The simulation leverages MPI for inter-process communication, enabling efficient parallel updates of agent positions and velocities while maintaining coherent flock behavior.
